LESSON: HADITH ON RESPONSIBLE USE OF HUMAN CAPABILITIES AND RESOURCES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.3 Hadith on planting (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub-strand, the lear
Topic 2.4: Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What bounties has Allah (S.W.T.) given to mankind?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources for character building
2. use the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) responsibly in day-to-day-life
3. appreciate the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) by acting responsibly to get His pleasure

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: HADITH ON RESPONSIBLE USE OF HUMAN CAPABILITIES AND RESOURCES
This lesson teaches Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources for Grade 6 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. read the Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources for character building
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) responsibly in day-to-day-life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) by acting responsibly to get His pleasure
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources above.
2. Explain Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What bounties has Allah (S.W.T.) given to mankind?
2. How should a Muslim use time wisely?
3. What activities may cause harm to people’s health?
4. How do you spend your pocket money?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read the Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources for character building
2. use the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) responsibly in day-to-day-life
3. appreciate the bounties of Allah (S.W.T.) by acting responsibly to get His pleasure

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
